verses.1: Death was raised up from Sheol like one who in his death for death [shed] his blood. From the dust he was raised up on the third night; he delivered himself to the Father. Even as the word of God, the Deep, out of which by the Spirit He breathed into Adam and gave him life. As Moses said in the wilderness: the prophets, the living ones, they were gathered together unto them; their gift is praise. Their praise and worship unto the ages of ages. Amen.
